scenes.title: 그림이 아니라 플레이하는 방
lines: Choose music, lie on the beanbag to read, and watch the rain while a calico cat sleeps nearby. This room started as an image and became a web game with connected actions, sound and notes. We follow the design, models and motion, then the changes driven by playing it.

scenes.title: 2D 방에서 이어지는 목표
lines: The pixel room was about choosing small activities and taking a break. Books, plants, warm light and notes carry over. We add depth, lighting and body movement. The three steps are design, models and motion, then playable interactions.

scenes.title: 도구를 역할로 나누기
lines: Choose tools by their jobs: images, 3D models, materials and motion, then the game engine. We place ten candidates along this workflow. This room mainly uses image generation, Tripo, coding and Unity. The screen distinguishes tools actually applied from alternatives.

scenes.title: 그림에서 먼저 정할 것
lines: First define the room palette and furniture relationships. The prompt combines warm wood, a cool night window, a teal-clothed character and a walking path. The concept guides later work. The playable room evolves to one monitor, a fireplace and a record-player table.

scenes.title: 캐릭터와 소품을 분리하기
lines: A single fused model of the room would make separate furniture and character interactions difficult. Prepare separate references for the hero and headphones. The hero has a neutral pose with arms separated from the torso; the prop clearly shows its ear cups and headband.

scenes.title: 이미지에서 3D로
lines: The references go into Tripo image-to-3D. These jobs used the images without an additional text prompt and selected H3.1. Rotate the exported hero and headphones to inspect the back, sides and thickness that the original view did not fully specify.

scenes.title: 같은 역할의 다른 선택지
lines: Other options at this stage include Meshy and ComfyUI with Hunyuan3D. Meshy handles model generation and processing; ComfyUI organizes node workflows and Hunyuan3D is the generation model. The actual room uses Tripo outputs. The others are alternatives to compare by environment and formats.

scenes.title: 가벼운 모델로 정리하기
lines: The initial hero had about 1.94 million triangles. Retopology reorganizes the surface into a lighter mesh: about ten thousand quad faces for the hero and two thousand triangles for the headphones. Inspect silhouettes and deformation after reduction.

scenes.title: 실제 비용과 출력 확인
lines: Recorded generation, retopology and rigging used 175 credits: 115 for the hero and 60 for the headphones. Those are observed figures for these jobs. The model exports include color, normal, roughness and metallic textures for Unity.

scenes.title: 색칠만으로 끝나지 않는 재질
lines: Color defines surface color. A normal map changes how fine surface detail responds to light. Roughness controls how reflections spread, and metallic separates metallic response. Connect all four inputs and inspect the model under lighting.

scenes.title: 규격이 중요한 가구
lines: Furniture must fit the character: knee clearance at the desk and grounded feet at the chair. Blockbench is an option for editable low-poly geometry. This room uses code-authored Unity geometry, so chair width and monitor height can be adjusted numerically.

scenes.title: 목재와 천을 다루는 방법
lines: Material Maker is an option for repeatable procedural materials made with nodes. This room implements wood, fabric and leaf details in Unity shaders. Distinguishing the method used from alternatives makes later substitutions easier.

scenes.title: 몸을 움직일 준비
lines: Rigging connects a skeleton to the surface. Unity Humanoid maps motion between compatible human rigs. Walking and idle come from the Tripo export. Sitting, standing and reading use licensed existing Humanoid clips.

scenes.title: 자동 리깅과 모션 캡처
lines: Mixamo and DeepMotion have different roles. Mixamo offers auto-rigging and existing motions; DeepMotion Animate 3D extracts movement from video. This room uses the existing clips we obtained. A compatible skeleton still needs fitted contacts with books and furniture.

scenes.title: 동작을 행동으로 연결하기
lines: Playing one clip differs from connecting activities. Computer use walks to the desk, aligns and sits. Reading leaves the desk, walks to the central beanbag, lies down and opens the book. Returning to the computer closes the book and gets up before walking. Explicit states and transitions keep movement connected.

scenes.title: 발과 이동 거리를 맞추기
lines: Travel distance should match the stride. This room follows the route using displacement from the native animation, called root motion. Floor fitting checks the posed character. Direction changes follow a smooth route instead of abrupt stationary swivels.

scenes.title: 차분하게 앉기
lines: The first version sat down too abruptly. We retime the same native sitting clip and smooth the seat-fitting blend. The hands then move toward the keyboard. A lower chair back and display also reveal the upper body and its action.

scenes.title: 빈백에서 기대어 읽기
lines: Reading becomes a break from desk work. A beanbag on the central carpet uses the installed KayKit lie-down, lying-idle and get-up clips. Native body animation is retained while contacts fit the cushion. The book-holding hand gradually follows its target. Inverse kinematics, IK, solves an arm pose from the hand target.

scenes.title: 머리카락에 여유를 주기
lines: Hair feels softer when its ends follow body motion with a delay. Keep the roots fixed and allow more motion toward the tips. Length, bend angle and head/shoulder constraints remain active after increasing the sway.

scenes.title: 잎과 창밖의 숲
lines: Plant bases stay fixed while leaf tips receive more wind. The window uses an original layered forest, moon and star panorama as its background. Its day/night colors change with the room lighting to establish a shared time of day.

scenes.title: 비가 보이지 않았던 이유
lines: Rain was hidden behind the outdoor background. Drawing it in front of the panorama within the visible window reveals distant streaks and sliding glass droplets. The button also shows its on state. Weather controls need a visible result.

scenes.title: 빛과 벽난로
lines: Window shafts and dust show the direction of incoming light. The hearth layers flames, small embers and smoke, with gently varying warm illumination. Moving fire and its light work together to create the atmosphere.

scenes.title: 열 곡을 고르는 레코드
lines: A single repeated song limits a long stay. Ten different complete tracks from our verified CC0 HoliznaCC0 collection support selection, previous and next. The record accelerates during playback and slows when paused. An asymmetric marker makes its rotation visible.

scenes.title: 코딩 화면과 잠자는 고양이
lines: A static display can make a powered computer feel frozen. Code documents and a cursor now change. A sleeping calico cat occupies a dedicated rug on the empty right side. Slow breathing, a small tail sway and occasional ear twitches use different quiet rhythms.

scenes.title: 메모가 남는 방
lines: Notes make the room useful for recording small thoughts. The PC build autosaves to a local file with a previous-copy backup. The web version uses storage in the same browser and origin. Game shortcuts are suppressed during typing, and Korean text and line breaks are checked after reopening.

scenes.title: 집중 시간도 연결하기
lines: The focus timer uses an end timestamp rather than counting rendered frames. Returning from another tab uses real elapsed time. Together with music, weather, reading and computer use, it lets the player choose the room state they need.

scenes.title: AI가 엔진을 다루는 연결
lines: Codex authors the integration code, while the official Unity CLI and MCP apply it to the scoped project. MCP connects the AI to tool calls. Imports, scene creation, state checks and builds are recorded, then verified against the actual running screen.

scenes.title: 브라우저에서 실행하기
lines: The Unity Web build packages browser code, models and textures. A loading indicator and retry control handle startup, and audio begins after the start button. Verify the running URL, activity transitions, volume and saved notes to finish the browser game.

scenes.title: 플레이하며 고친 다섯 가지
lines: The play-driven changes follow five steps: a central beanbag with lying transitions makes reading restful; rain moves in front of the window background; the iMac code changes; a sleeping cat fills the empty space; and ten selectable songs drive visible record rotation. The goal is a room worth staying in, rather than only a pleasing image.

scenes.title: 이 방에서 실제로 바뀐 것
lines: Compare the concept with the playable room: separate assets, fitted furniture, connected actions and persistent notes. AI provides starting images and models; making a game also requires scale, contacts, states and storage. The result can be checked by playing it.

scenes.title: 그림을 게임으로 바꾸는 세 단계
lines: Match the design, refine models and motion, then connect interactions and storage. Those three steps turn an image into a game.
